capabilities: Render folders of notes as a masonry card board with pinning, fuzzy search, and filter chips
Expand cards in place to read the full note with live Markdown rendering
Switch nooks to a Kanban layout and recategorize cards by dragging between columns
Register a custom Carrel view type for Obsidian Bases files
Infer or assign card types and user-defined categories with colors and icons
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; pre-release builds are available through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Carrel registers a "Carrel" view type for any .base file
motivation: It began as the References tab of the Wayfinder character sheet before becoming a standalone plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a set of notes as a visual card wall, pin and filter them, and read each note in place without leaving the board.

relations.evidence: Carrel grew out of Wayfinder, a character-sheet plugin.
When it's installed, Carrel hands rolls off to it
Accent colors and fonts are customizable through the Style Settings plugin.
BRAT (the Beta Reviewers Auto-update Tool) installs and updates pre-release builds

summary: Card-board viewer that renders folders of notes as a column-balancing wall of typed reference cards, with pinning, filtering, a Kanban layout, and a Bases view.
